prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” lawyer for every car wreck — the right attorney depends on the specifics of your crash, injuries, budget, and how you want the case handled. I can help you find a good fit; to start, here’s what I recommend and what to look for.

Quick questions so I can give targeted referrals
- Where in Houston (ZIP or general area) are you located?  
- When did the crash happen? (This matters for the 2‑year statute of limitations in Texas.)  
- Were there serious or catastrophic injuries? Any ongoing treatment?  
- Do you want a boutique personal‑injury specialist or a large firm with lots of resources?  
- Any preference for language, budget, or trial lawyer vs settlement negotiator?

Important legal facts (Texas)
- Statute of limitations for most personal‑injury claims: 2 years from the date of the crash (Texas Civ. Prac. & Rem. Code §16.003). Act promptly.  
- Most car‑wreck PI lawyers in Houston work on contingency (no fee unless you recover). Typical contingency fees range 33%–40% depending on whether the case settles or goes to trial.

How to pick the best lawyer for your wreck
- Relevant experience: Ask how many car wreck cases they handle each year and outcomes for cases like yours (neck/back soft‑tissue vs. catastrophic injury).  
- Verdicts/settlements and trial experience: A lawyer who will actually try your case often gets better settlement offers.  
- Resources: Do they have investigators, medical experts, and paralegals to handle discovery and medical liens?  
- Communication: Who will you talk to (attorney vs. staff)? How often will you get updates?  
- Fees and costs: Confirm contingency percentage, whether you advance costs, and how costs are deducted from recovery.  
- Client reviews and peer ratings: Check Google, Avvo/Martindale, and Super Lawyers lists.  
- License/discipline: Verify good standing with the State Bar of Texas.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many car crash cases like mine have you handled? Outcome examples?  
- Who will handle my case day‑to‑day? Will it go to trial if needed?  
- What is your contingency fee and how are costs handled?  
- How long do you expect this case to take?  
- Can you provide references or sample results for similar cases?

Documents to bring to a consultation
- Police report, photos of the scene/vehicles/injuries, medical records/bills, auto insurance info (yours and other driver’s), wage loss documentation, correspondence with insurers.

How I can help next
- If you give me your ZIP code and a few details (date of crash, injury severity), I can suggest several highly rated Houston personal‑injury attorneys and draft a short message you can use to contact them.  
- Or I can create a checklist and a consultation script you can use when you meet attorneys.

If you want a quick shortlist now, tell me your ZIP code and whether the injuries are minor, moderate, or catastrophic and I’ll prepare tailored recommendations.
